name: Fall Into Prayer
source:
Your life only changed for the better after converting to a new religion. And now it seems you've been chosen by god for a very important role.

[From [url=https://games-of-crimsin.itch.io/fall-into-prayer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自從改信一種新的宗教，你的生活就一直在往好的方向發展。如今，神似乎選中了你，要你擔起一個非常重要的角色。

［摘自[url=https://games-of-crimsin.itch.io/fall-into-prayer]itch.io[/url]］
